title: TreviPay pricing - Starts around $200/month plus usage-based and financing fees
clean_text: TreviPay pricing varies by program and is not fully published. Third-party aggregator listings indicate pricing starts from roughly $200 per month with usage-based options, including per-invoice fees and financing fees that scale with transaction volume. No detailed tier breakdown is publicly available; full pricing requires contacting TreviPay directly and negotiating based on program type (Private Network, TreviPay Network, or Small Business Supplier Network) and transaction volume.
